title: Underlying signed twist maps and normalized inverse-image comparisons
statement: The underlying additive sheaf of the canonical signed integral twist line, its coefficient-inclusion map, and the adjunct section map for a signed inverse-image family. A normalized inverse-image comparison preserves the coefficient unit, root tensors, coefficient action, positive tensor recursion and negative evaluation. These are the verbatim definitions formerly in IntegralTwistBaseChange. Uses [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], [lem-pur-integral-twist-line-inverse-image] and [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image].
